title: Degree-one Fourier part as a linear form
statement: For any real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube and any point $x$ of that cube, the degree-one part of the Fourier expansion of $f$ at $x$ equals the linear form whose coefficient at coordinate $i$ is the Fourier coefficient of $f$ on the singleton set $\{i\}$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
